calculation.description: At each decision date, rank instruments by the negative lagged three-session close-to-close return. Higher percentile denotes stronger recent underperformance and a larger contrarian signal. The signal uses only completed prices through t and predicts return from t to t+1.
calculation.lag: Signal is formed at t from data through t; forward return is t to t+1.

validation.period: 2020-01-01 through 2027-12-02 available history, forward one session
validation.regime_notes: Validated across the available synthetic cross-asset history and many dates using the 15-instrument universe. ICIR exceeds the benchmark admission threshold only narrowly; uncertainty is high because each daily cross-section is small.
